articles.author: CEMTREX INC
articles.headline: Cemtrex Reports Preliminary Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results
articles.summary: Cemtrex reports preliminary unaudited fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $22.7 million, operating income of $1.4 million and operating EBITDA of $1.9 million. These are preliminary figures; final annual results were to follow in its Form 10-K.
